cards.title: Study of note-taking help centers: products, structure, competitors
cards.body: Scope: frame the new Getting started section of the Acme Notes help center. Steps: 1) describe the help center of 8 comparable note-taking products (sections, guides, templates, search), each with its source and the date it was read; 2) draw 5 trends and list what is not verified as such; 3) give every figure its source and the date it was read; 4) mark what is not verified as not verified, never guess; 5) write no article and publish nothing; 6) prefer the primary source to a page that quotes it; 7) end with a short list of what remains uncertain. Out of scope: writing the content, choosing the plan, any contact with a third party. Acceptance criteria: every statement can be traced to a dated source and the uncertainties are visible. Proof: the study, its table and the dated list of sources.

cards.title: Keyword study and clusters for the Getting started section
cards.body: Scope: from the study of c1, what people search for when they start with a note-taking app. Steps: 1) group the queries into 4 to 6 clusters with their search intent; 2) give the source and the date of each volume; 3) give each volume its source and its date; 4) write tickets for the others instead of changing their work; 5) check that no two pages answer the same intent. Out of scope: the copy, the server code. Acceptance criteria: the pages validate, each one has its title, its description and its canonical, and no page is an orphan. Proof: the output of the validators and the table page by page.

cards.title: Editorial plan: 6 guides, 12 template pages, briefs and internal linking
cards.body: Scope: the content plan of the section, one cluster per guide. Steps: 1) write a brief per guide (angle, outline, questions, title) and a short one per template page; 2) plan the internal links by name and check that no intent is treated twice; 3) write tickets for the others instead of changing their work; 4) check that no two pages answer the same intent. Out of scope: writing the texts, changing the templates, the choice of the products named. Acceptance criteria: one page per intent, every keyword has a dated source and the links planned are named page by page. Proof: the table and the briefs, placed with the plan.

cards.title: Review of the editorial plan before the human validation
cards.body: Scope: the plan of c3 against the study of c1. Steps: 1) count the briefs and check that each keyword has a dated source; 2) look for two briefs that answer the same intent; 3) number each finding and say how to reproduce it; 4) end with a verdict: validated, changes requested or blocked. Out of scope: fixing what you find yourself. Acceptance criteria: every criterion of the card reviewed is checked one by one and the verdict follows from the findings. Proof: the numbered findings and the commands that were run.

cards.title: Writing of the 6 Getting started guides
cards.body: Scope: the 6 guides, each from its brief. Steps: 1) follow the outline and answer every question of the brief; 2) check each step of a guide in the real app; 3) list what could not be verified; 4) write from what can be checked in the code, the data or the briefs, and invent nothing. Out of scope: changing the code, adding a feature, deciding the content plan. Acceptance criteria: nothing is stated that the sources do not say, the format of the project is respected and every text has its place. Proof: the files written and the list of the sources used.

cards.title: Writing of the 12 template pages
cards.body: Scope: the 12 template pages, from their briefs. Steps: 1) fill every field of the page model; 2) check each plan limit against the app; 3) write from what can be checked in the code, the data or the briefs, and invent nothing. Out of scope: the layout of the pages, the technical integration. Acceptance criteria: each text answers its brief, no sentence is invented and the lengths fit where they go. Proof: the texts, with for each one the brief or the source it comes from.

cards.title: Spanish translation of the guides and template pages
cards.body: Scope: the validated English texts, into Spanish. Steps: 1) keep the structure, the links and the names of the interface; 2) flag what cannot be translated as is; 3) read the text once more against the real behaviour. Out of scope: changing the code, adding a feature, deciding the content plan. Acceptance criteria: nothing is stated that the sources do not say, the format of the project is respected and every text has its place. Proof: the files written and the list of the sources used.

cards.title: Editorial review of the English and Spanish content
cards.body: Scope: the texts of c5, c6 and c7. Steps: 1) read each text against its brief; 2) compare a sample of the two languages; 3) look for a regression next to the change, not only in it. Out of scope: fixing what you find yourself. Acceptance criteria: every criterion of the card reviewed is checked one by one and the verdict follows from the findings. Proof: the numbered findings and the commands that were run.

cards.title: Licence notices, privacy mentions and dated plan limits
cards.body: Scope: the template pages and the guides, once reviewed. Steps: 1) add the licence notice of each template and the privacy mention where a page collects something; 2) date each plan limit quoted. Out of scope: writing the content, changing the plans or their limits, any contact with a third party. Acceptance criteria: no notice is missing, each limit quoted has its date and every gap has a ticket. Proof: the real output of the automatic checks, attached as it is, and a table page by page.

cards.title: Templates of the section, structured data and internal linking
cards.body: Scope: the three page templates of the section, on the site. Steps: 1) build the index, the guide and the template page; 2) add the structured data and the links of the plan; 3) run the build and the tests before handing over. Out of scope: the API, the content, a redesign of the screens that are not named. Acceptance criteria: no regression of the existing screens, keyboard use works end to end and the console stays empty. Proof: the diff, the output of the tests and before and after screenshots.

cards.title: Integration of the content into the site and sitemap
cards.body: Scope: the content of c9 in the templates of c10. Steps: 1) load the guides and the pages into the site; 2) generate the sitemap of the section; 3) log nothing that identifies a user or the content of a note. Out of scope: the interface, the visual design, any change of infrastructure. Acceptance criteria: the tests pass, extra fields are refused, each refusal has its own code and no behaviour outside the scope changes. Proof: the real output of the test run and the list of the files changed.

cards.title: QA acceptance of the section in staging
cards.body: Scope: the section on the staging site. Steps: 1) run the journeys index, guide, template page; 2) test the keyboard and three screen widths; 3) try the edge cases: empty content, a very long title, a slow network, a second tab. Out of scope: changing the code under test. Acceptance criteria: no journey is left untested and no bug is reported without its steps. Proof: the list of journeys with their result and the tests added.

cards.title: Technical SEO audit and design check of the section
cards.body: Scope: the staging pages of the section. Steps: 1) check titles, canonicals, structured data and links; 2) compare the rendering with the rest of the site. Out of scope: writing the texts, changing the templates, the choice of the products named. Acceptance criteria: one page per intent, every keyword has a dated source and the links planned are named page by page. Proof: the table and the briefs, placed with the plan.

cards.title: Final review before the go-live validation
cards.body: Scope: the reports of c12 and c13. Steps: 1) check that each finding is fixed or justified; 2) run the build again; 3) number each finding and say how to reproduce it. Out of scope: fixing what you find yourself. Acceptance criteria: every criterion of the card reviewed is checked one by one and the verdict follows from the findings. Proof: the numbered findings and the commands that were run. Stop and ask if a criterion cannot be measured.

cards.title: Go-live of the section and post-deployment check
cards.body: Scope: the deployment of the section to production. Steps: 1) deploy from the validated commit with a backup; 2) open 6 pages in production and read the logs. Out of scope: changing the application code, any action on a service that is not named. Acceptance criteria: the pipeline is green on the commit delivered, the build can be reproduced and the way back was tried. Proof: the output of the pipeline, the checksum of the build and the log of the commands.
